cmd-1792787374697.value: {"command":"$files = @('.vscode\\launch.json', 'start.py', 'tools\\test_nginx_facade.py', 'pytest.ini', 'pyproject.toml', 'setup.cfg'); foreach ($file in $files) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { Write-Output \"FOUND $file\" } else { Write-Output \"MISSING $file\" } }; Write-Output '--- .vscode files ---'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.vscode') { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '.vscode' -Force | Select-Object Name,Length }; Write-Output '--- git status ---'; git status --short; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.vscode\\launch.json') { Write-Output '--- launch.json ---'; Get-Content -LiteralPath '.vscode\\launch.json' -Raw }","exitCode":0,"success":true}

cmd-1792787385398.value: {"command":"$parsed = Get-Content -LiteralPath '.vscode\\launch.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output (\"JSON_OK version={0} configurations={1}\" -f $parsed.version, $parsed.configurations.Count); Write-Output '--- launch diff ---'; git diff -- .vscode/launch.json; Write-Output '--- referenced targets ---'; $parsed.configurations | ForEach-Object { if ($_.program) { $resolved = $_.program.Replace('${workspaceFolder}', (Get-Location).Path); if ($resolved -eq '${file}') { Write-Output (\"DYNAMIC {0}: current editor file\" -f $_.name) } else { Write-Output (\"{0} {1}: {2}\" -f $(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolved) {'OK'} else {'MISSING'}), $_.name, $resolved) } } elseif ($_.module) { Write-Output (\"MODULE {0}: {1}\" -f $_.name, $_.module) } }; Write-Output '--- start.py port declarations ---'; rg -n --glob 'start.py' -- '--port|port' start.py","exitCode":0,"success":true}

cmd-1792788985500.value: {"command":"Write-Output '--- TCP 1337 listeners ---'; $listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1337 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($listeners.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'NONE' } else { foreach ($listener in $listeners) { $process = Get-Process -Id $listener.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ LocalAddress = $listener.LocalAddress; LocalPort = $listener.LocalPort; PID = $listener.OwningProcess; Process = $process.ProcessName; Started = $process.StartTime } | Format-List } }; Write-Output '--- start.py lines 145-185 ---'; $lineNumber = 0; Get-Content -LiteralPath 'start.py' | ForEach-Object { $lineNumber++; if ($lineNumber -ge 145 -and $lineNumber -le 185) { '{0,4}: {1}' -f $lineNumber, $_ } }; Write-Output '--- handler.py lines 75-100 ---'; $lineNumber = 0; Get-Content -LiteralPath 'server\\handler.py' | ForEach-Object { $lineNumber++; if ($lineNumber -ge 75 -and $lineNumber -le 100) { '{0,4}: {1}' -f $lineNumber, $_ } }; Write-Output '--- launch args ---'; $launch = Get-Content -LiteralPath '.vscode\\launch.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $launch.configurations | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = $_.name; Program = $_.program; Module = $_.module; Args = ($_.args -join ' ') } } | Format-Table -AutoSize","exitCode":0,"success":true}
